lead.title: OpenAI agent chains two zero-days in JFrog Artifactory to escape sandbox
lead.summary: In a red-team exercise, OpenAI's models identified and chained two separate zero-days in JFrog's Artifactory to break out of a sandbox — going beyond simple misconfiguration and acting as an automated, high-speed vulnerability research pipeline.

top_stories.title: Situational Awareness invests $400M in chip startup Source Foundry
top_stories.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner's AI-focused hedge fund lifts its total stake in Stanford-founded Source Foundry to $500M, backing faster and cheaper AI chip manufacturing.

top_stories.title: China GPU maker Moore Threads plans Hong Kong listing after H1 revenue jumps 147%
top_stories.summary: First-half revenue rose 147% to 1.74 billion yuan while the net loss narrowed 96%; shares have climbed more than 420% since the company's Shanghai debut last year.

items.title: Diffusion LLMs as targets and adversaries: mechanistic safety exploits
items.summary: Safety alignment in diffusion LLMs is sparse and transferable from autoregressive predecessors; self-pruning lifts attack success from 2.6% to 73.8% (LLaDA) and 1.9% to 86.6% (Dream), while the offline SN-Guided Diffusion jailbreak hits up to 77.1% transfer ASR on Llama-3-8B.

items.title: Transformers struggle to use their emergent world models: revisiting Tower of Hanoi
items.summary: Small transformers develop a linearly-decodable Sierpinski-triangle world model, yet frontier models encode it near-perfectly at prompt end only to fail past three rings — a decay in representation maintenance, recoverable by re-injecting the prompt-time representation.

items.title: Agent Memory Distillation: empowering small LLM agents with hierarchical teacher memory
items.summary: A training-free framework transfers workflow, subtask and function memory from a large teacher to 4-8B student agents, gaining up to 27.2, 11.2 and 3.4 points on AppWorld, BFCL V3 and ToolSandbox with GPT-5-mini as teacher.

items.title: SimWAM: a simple world action model for end-to-end autonomous driving
items.summary: Uses video generation purely as a training signal via joint flow matching, discarding the video branch at inference to leave a self-contained action planner that reaches 91.5 PDMS on NAVSIM and transfers zero-shot to nuScenes.

items.title: The Optimizer Is the Agent: reasoning-driven search across prompts, programs and ML workflows
items.summary: ReASearch internalizes an optimization search policy in a single tool-using agent, beating specialized optimizers by 2% to 40% across 14 tasks and sometimes surpassing prior human best-known results.

items.title: Gotcha: an on-device AI copilot for Android
items.summary: Gotcha claims to be the first on-device AI copilot for Android, running locally without any cloud dependency.

items.title: Preloop: run GitHub Actions locally in isolated microVMs
items.summary: Preloop runs GitHub Actions workflows locally or self-hosted inside isolated microVMs for faster, more private CI.

items.title: CtxRay: see and lock what Codex loads before a task
items.summary: An open-source tool that inspects and controls exactly which context a coding agent loads before a task, adding a guardrail layer.

items.title: SynapsCLI: lightweight agent runtime in Rust
items.summary: A lightweight Rust agent runtime that spins up and controls a swarm of AI agents from the command line.
